課程概述: 本課程目的主要在於建立學生基本的國際私法理論概念、協助學生思考並培養解決國際私法問題之能力。針對大四學生，採用「立體化」的法律教學概念：即連結點、線、面的理論基礎，輔以司法實務高度作為整體國際私法「建築」概念之方式，不但計畫在理論的縱深上詳細說明各項概念，並且期待能培養學生面對未來涉外民事實務細節時，能具備有系統的思考與解決問題能力。
法理學是一門探討「什麼是法律」、「法律之正當性」、「法律與道德、社會、政治之關係為何」的學問。本課程以思想史的脈絡出發從古希臘羅馬自然法思想、中世紀基督教法思想，到近代社會契約論、啟蒙時期的法哲學，循序介紹思想脈絡如何塑造現代法治國家的基本原則。除此之外，亦會介紹當代英美分析法理學以及歐陸法哲學思想，讓學生了解當前法理學的樣貌。透過不同時代以及不同流派的思想，引導學生去思考法學背後的思想與理論。

法學方法論不僅關乎到如何進行法律論證以及如何認事用法，在法之續造時亦扮演重要的角色。本課程以我國繼受德國法學傳統為背景，分為兩大部分進行。第一部分解說 19 世紀以來的德國法學，介紹從歷史法學派、學說編篡學（Pandektistik）、利益法學、評價法學等各階段法學思想帶來的方法論變遷，並說明這些理論如何影響到我國法律，特別是民法相關的論證方式與思考方式。第二部分則聚焦於不同解釋方法在我國法律制度中的實際運用。課程將探討文義、體系、歷史與目的解釋等基本解釋方法如何運用在具體事例中，並且討論法律漏洞的不同填補方式。透過判決、案例討論與方法論比較，學生將學習如何在具體法律問題中提出論證、推論以及解釋法律。
法學是社會生活的科學。人與人從事工商交易、成立家庭、養育子女、承繼遺產以及參與政府組織、享用公共資源、行使公民權利、擔負社會義務時，均會受到法律之規範。因此，可以說法律是我們日常公、私生活不可或缺之科學。本課程即介紹公、私生活所必要的法學知識。

課程概述: 授課人在教學現場觀察到一個奇妙的現象，亦即「老師的教學受有非常高度評價」，而且「學生們具有高度學習參與與學習動機」但卻仍然只有「低度學習成效」的產出。這個觀察，顯然是反於一般論所認知的常識，而此一反常現象，便促使授課人欲深入著手研究。為此，授課人以「以『排除跨課程系統性學習障礙』為目的之『融貫式槓桿課程』對法律系學生高階能力養成之有效性研究」為題申請教育部教學研究計畫並獲通過（PSL1090132，下稱109實踐研究）。經109實踐研究實證發現，系統性學習障礙之最顯著病徵，體現在學生們（全部履修者，不論年級）皆有一個共同的學習盲點，亦即，只要面對嶄新劇情的實例題就無法看出爭點。換言之，他們只能解決課堂上已經講授過之一模一樣的實例題。然而，司律之國考考題在設計上，理所當然必含有大一刑法總則與大二刑法分則的諸多考點，係將之融合後所嶄新設計的實例題。學生們初見該實例題，往往不知該從何著手加以解題。然事實上，解答該國考考題所需運用的法理，其實在刑法總則與刑法分則之課堂上應該已然學過。而之所以學生們普遍上仍然有完全不知從何著手加以解題之情形，此點，透過109實踐研究之結果可知，導致此一情形之學習障礙有二，其一，學生們對於刑法分則之理解多數係流於零碎片段之死記硬背，其二，渠等多數存在有跨年級的系統性學習障礙，亦即完全無法自行將大一刑總與大二刑分之所學內容予以融會貫通。為此，授課人特開設本課程，擬在刑法總則之底蘊上，以刑法分則為架構，設計體系式之案例研究與實作課程，來克服前揭兩項學習障礙。具體上，所設定分為「個人法益」、「社會法益」與「國家法益」三章節，在刑法總則犯罪三階段論證之基礎上，以「法益論」與「條文解釋適用」為體系建構重點，於此之上進行「案例解析」之方法論講授、解題示範與例題實作演練。

本課程旨在引導學生認識西方法律傳統的歷史發展，並理解現代法律制度背後的歷史脈絡與思想基礎。西方法律的根源可追溯至羅馬法，其制度與觀念對後世歐洲各國法律發展具有決定性影響，尤其深植於今日大陸法系（Civil Law）的民法體系當中。課程內容將以羅馬法為出發點，介紹羅馬法如何在中世紀透過大學的法學教育體系得以「復興」與「繼受」，並對近代歐陸各國，特別是德意志地區，產生深遠影響。課程將聚焦於私法發展的歷史軌跡，從中世紀開始，一直到德國民法典（BGB）的制定，並進一步探討對於台灣之影響。透過歷史的視角，學生將能建立對私法史與比較法的基本認識，並理解今日法律與法理背後所蘊含的歷史因素與思想基礎，深化對於實定法以及法律基礎的理解。

課程概述:
History of states（國家學） explores the idea of the “State” and how state power has evolved in Eastern and Western traditions. As an interdisciplinary course, it introduces core concepts of political order, legitimacy, sovereignty, state formation, and institutional organization. Rather than treating the state as an abstract idea, the course examines how different states are imagined, created, justified and challenged. Through case studies such as the French Republic and United Nations, students connect theory with historical practice and critically assess competing forms of statehood and political authority. 

國家學導論探討「國家」這個概念，以及國家權力如何在不同歷史脈絡中形成和演變。作為一門學術交叉的課程，本課程將介紹政治秩序、權力正當、主權思維、國家形成與制度組織等核心概念。課程在抽象的理論之外將會討論實際的案例，追問不同國家如何被創造、權力如何正當化。透過法國革命，三十年戰爭和聯合國的創建等等不同的案例，學生將在案例中瞭解理論的實踐，并且進一步批判不同國家的形態與政治權威的競爭。

This course "Talking on Modern Rights"（比較憲法） will provide a comparative perspective on civil rights in different states and international contracts, the course will explore the historical foundation and contemporary challenges of basic rights through a comparative lens, focusing on the Constitution of United States and the Basic Law “Grundgesetz” of Germany. Starting with the philosophical
explanation of natural rights, human rights and constitutional rights, the lecture will illustrate the tension between the is and the
ought. The course will further examine specific constitutional protections in the U.S. Bill of Rights and the
German Grundgesetz, national protection of rights that are anchored alongside international treaties and human rights conventions.
Basic rights such as freedom of speech, freedom of religion, protection of property will be analyzed across different constitutional
systems, against the background of contemporary menace to these rights such as digital surveillance, climate change,
disinformation, and the rise of populism. By the end of the semester, students will have gained a critical understanding of civil
rights and the diversity of constitutional traditions, the theoretical understanding should then be proven by individual presentations
and analysis of controversial cases.
比較憲法是一門從比較視角探討不同國家的公民權利與基本權利的課程。本課程全英文授課，將以美國憲法與德國《基本法》（Grundgesetz）為核心，追溯歐美憲法的歷史基礎，並討論其在當代社會所面臨的挑戰。課程首先從自然權利、人權與憲法權利的哲學基礎出發，說明「現實如何存在」與「規範應當如何」的議題。課程將進一步分析美國《權利法案》與德國《基本法》中具體的憲法保障。探討言論自由、宗教自由、財產權保障等基本權利，課程將在不同憲政傳統中進行權利的比較和分析。學期結束時，學生將能夠批判性地理解公民權利的意義、基本權利保障的多樣性，以及不同憲法傳統如何回應現代社會的政治與法律挑戰。學生也將透過個人報告與爭議案例分析，將理論理解轉化為具體的判斷能力。

耶林有言：羅馬人曾三次征服世界，頭一次以武力，第二次以宗教，第三次以法律。羅馬法自中世紀以來在歐洲被重新發現並加以繼受，隨著近代歐洲與世界各地的持續接觸與擴大，其影響力擴及到許多羅馬人未曾踏足的地區，成為現代法律的共通歷史源頭。不只在大陸法系的市民法國家，甚至在英美普通法系國家中，都可以看到羅馬法在這些現代法律制度之中之影響。課程首先介紹羅馬法史以及法學的分期。接著以Gaius法學階梯之順序，探討人法：亦即人格與身份法，接著是羅馬法物權與債權法的基本概念，以及訴訟制度的介紹之及重點相關訴訟。
課程內容不僅著重概念與制度的理解，亦會以現代法的觀點進行比較與省思，協助學生建立跨法系的視野，並為民法以及法比較研究等不同法領域奠定堅實基礎。無需具備先備知識，也不需具備拉丁文閱讀能力，歡迎大學部以及研究所各年級的學生選修。

The SENM program is a student-centered module-based program which offers students choices and small, interactive classes. The program encourages students to tailor their English learning to their specific needs and interests by offering four semester-based modules: Career and Profession, Daily Communication, Multiculturalism, and Self-Expression Skills. Additionally, within each of the four modules, there are different themes, or topics, around which each course‘s curriculum is built. Each SENM student can choose two different module courses in one academic year according to their needs and interests. The program’s small class size (no more than 25 students) means that a variety of class activities such as discussions, role plays, and presentations are an integral part of the program.  

This specific course belongs to the Career and Profession Module. This module focuses on different specialized fields that can help students increase their professional competence in English and prepare them for jobs of the future.

Course Objectives:
On completion of the course, students should be able to
1) demonstrate their communicative competence in relation to the specific theme of the course;
2) use skills acquired in the course to explore specific topics related to their career and professional development;
3) use specialized vocabulary and terms to express themselves more professionally; and
4) effectively communicate with others in practical, profession-oriented situations.

「大二英文」是一個以學習者為中心的模組化課程。針對學生個人學習興趣及相關系所之專業需求，開設四大模組課程，分別為「職涯與專業」、「日常溝通」、「多元文化」以及「自我表達技巧」。四大模組分別由具有共同核心目標但涵蓋不同主題之課程所建構而成。所有的課程均以學期為單位，學生根據個別興趣及需求，必須於兩學期選擇兩門不同的模組課程。本課程結合討論、展演及實作等各類學習活動，讓學生能在更多元、自主的學習語境中，具體強化其英語文溝通能力。

本課程屬於「自我表達技巧」模組，透過多元題材與多媒體資源提升教學成效，協助學生增進英語聆聽與口說能力，具體提升學生的表達能力與自信，並精進其英語簡報及演說技巧。

The SENM program is a student-centered module-based program which offers students choices and interactive classes. The program encourages students to tailor their English learning to their specific needs and interests by offering four semester-based modules: Career and Profession, Daily Communication, Multiculturalism, and Self-Expression Skills. Additionally, within each of the four modules, there are different themes, or topics, around which each course‘s curriculum is built. Each SENM student must choose two different module courses in two semesters according to their interests and needs. A variety of class activities such as discussions, role plays, and presentations is incorporated into the program to provide a more effective and productive learning environment for the students.  

This specific course belongs to the Self-Expression Skills Module. This module enhances students’ oral presentation techniques. It also helps students to improve their listening skills and boost their confidence in public speaking.

Course Objectives: 
On completion of the course, students should be able to
1) deliver a variety of formal and informal presentations in English;
2) present ideas clearly with emphasis on effective use of verbal and nonverbal communication skills;
3) demonstrate critical thinking skills in daily life communication, both as a speaker and as a listener; and
4) express their ideas in English more confidently.

評分方式.說明: 10% In-class + 10% Digital Learning

課程概述:

本課程屬於「職涯與專業」模組。針對不同學院開設符合其職涯專業需求的英語文課程。透過英文能力的提升，具體強化學生未來就業需求與職場競爭力。

The SENM program is a student-centered module-based program which offers students choices and small, interactive classes. The program encourages students to tailor their English learning to their specific needs and interests by offering four semester-based modules: Career and Profession, Daily Communication, Multiculturalism, and Self-Expression Skills. Additionally, within each of the four modules, there are different themes, or topics, around which each course‘s curriculum is built. Each SENM student can choose two different module courses in one academic year according to their needs and interests. The program’s small class size (no more than 25 students) means that a variety of class activities such as discussions, role plays, and presentations are an integral part of the program.  

This specific course belongs to the Career and Profession Module. This module focuses on different specialized fields that can help students increase their professional competence in English and prepare them for jobs of the future.

Course Objectives:
On completion of the course, students should be able to
1) demonstrate their communicative competence in relation to the specific theme of the course;
2) use skills acquired in the course to explore specific topics related to their career and professional development;
3) use specialized vocabulary and terms to express themselves more professionally; and
4) effectively communicate with others in practical, profession-oriented situations.

評分方式.說明: 20% In-class + 10% Digital Learning

「大二英文」是一個以學習者為中心的模組化課程。針對學生個人學習興趣及相關系所之專業需求，開設四大模組課程，分別為「職涯與專業」、「日常溝通」、「多元文化」以及「自我表達技巧」。四大模組分別由具有共同核心目標但涵蓋不同主題之課程所建構而成。所有的課程均以學期為單位，學生根據個別興趣及需求，必須於兩學期選擇兩門不同的模組課程。本課程結合討論、展演及實作等各類學習活動，讓學生能在更多元、自主的學習語境中，具體強化其英語文溝通能力。

本課程屬於「自我表達技巧」模組，透過多元題材與多媒體資源提升教學成效，協助學生增進英語聆聽與口說能力，具體提升學生的表達能力與自信，並精進其英語簡報及演說技巧。

The SENM program is a student-centered module-based program which offers students choices and interactive classes. The program encourages students to tailor their English learning to their specific needs and interests by offering four semester-based modules: Career and Profession, Daily Communication, Multiculturalism, and Self-Expression Skills. Additionally, within each of the four modules, there are different themes, or topics, around which each course‘s curriculum is built. Each SENM student must choose two different module courses in two semesters according to their interests and needs. A variety of class activities such as discussions, role plays, and presentations is incorporated into the program to provide a more effective and productive learning environment for the students.  

This specific course belongs to the Self-Expression Skills Module. This module enhances students’ oral presentation techniques. It also helps students to improve their listening skills and boost their confidence in public speaking.

Course Objectives: 
On completion of the course, students should be able to
1) deliver a variety of formal and informal presentations in English;
2) present ideas clearly with emphasis on effective use of verbal and nonverbal communication skills;
3) demonstrate critical thinking skills in daily life communication, both as a speaker and as a listener; and
4) express their ideas in English more confidently.

評分方式.說明: 10% In-class + 10% Digital Learning

本課程屬於「職涯與專業」模組。針對不同學院開設符合其職涯專業需求的英語文課程。透過英文能力的提升，具體強化學生未來就業需求與職場競爭力。

The SENM program is a student-centered module-based program which offers students choices and small, interactive classes. The program encourages students to tailor their English learning to their specific needs and interests by offering four semester-based modules: Career and Profession, Daily Communication, Multiculturalism, and Self-Expression Skills. Additionally, within each of the four modules, there are different themes, or topics, around which each course‘s curriculum is built. Each SENM student can choose two different module courses in one academic year according to their needs and interests. The program’s small class size (no more than 25 students) means that a variety of class activities such as discussions, role plays, and presentations are an integral part of the program.  

This specific course belongs to the Career and Profession Module. This module focuses on different specialized fields that can help students increase their professional competence in English and prepare them for jobs of the future.

Course Objectives:
On completion of the course, students should be able to
1) demonstrate their communicative competence in relation to the specific theme of the course;
2) use skills acquired in the course to explore specific topics related to their career and professional development;
3) use specialized vocabulary and terms to express themselves more professionally; and
4) effectively communicate with others in practical, profession-oriented situations.

評分方式.說明: 10% In-class + 10% Digital Learning

4) express themselves in English more confidently.

課程概述: This course is a general survey of the arts, including the history of painting and architecture from the classical Greco-Roman world, Buddhist and Islamic traditions, to medieval and Renaissance art. We will examine representative artworks from these cultural traditions through the lens of Semiotics and focus on the following themes: 1) The Elgin Marbles Controversy; 2) Hitler’s 1936 Summer Olympics; 3) Staging Power & Violence: Rome’s Entertainment Industry; 4) Symbolism in Buddha’s Body; 5) Divinity in the Flesh: Imagery of God, Christ and Madonna in Medieval and Renaissance art; 6) Mysticism of the Light and Gothic Cathedrals. After completing the course, students can 1) Appreciate art & architecture through the lens of social and art history, 2) Enhance cross-cultural competence and aesthetic literacy, 3) Enhance communicative and presentation skills.

課程概述: Statistics is the science that deals with the collection, description, analysis, interpretation, and presentation of data. Statistics can be used to describe a particular data set (descriptive statistics) as well as to draw conclusions about the population from a particular data set (inferential statistics). Business Statistics applies statistical methods in a business context in order to address business related questions and help make evidence based decisions. In this course you will learn to apply commonly used statistical methods in business contexts and how to interpret analyses performed by others.

Group project applying statistical methods to a business dataset and presenting practical business recommendations.
Individual Excel practice, problem-solving tasks, AI scaffolded worksheets, interpretation logs, transfer tasks, and Moodle submissions.
Individual final exam covering key statistical concepts, calculations, interpretation, and business application questions.

課程概述: This course introduces students to the fundamental concepts and applications of business statistics for evidence-based decision-making. Students will learn how to collect, organize, summarize, analyze, interpret, and present data in business contexts. Major topics include data collection, data visualization, descriptive statistics, probability, probability distributions, normal distribution, sampling theory, sampling distributions, confidence interval estimation, and hypothesis testing. The course emphasizes both statistical understanding and practical interpretation rather than mechanical calculation alone. Through lectures, problem-solving exercises, data interpretation activities, AI scaffolded learning tasks, and applied business data projects, students will learn to use statistical reasoning to support managerial decisions. Students will also use AI tools responsibly to clarify statistical concepts, evaluate AI generated explanations, connect outputs to statistical rules, revise interpretations, and apply statistical thinking to real business problems.

課程概述:
This course explores body, gender, and sexuality in pre-modern Western and Chinese cultural discourses. We will historicize gender, sexuality, and the body in the following sources: 1) Sex change and same-sex desire from Greco-Roman mythology and Galenic medical traditions; 2) Ambiguous Bodies in the Medieval and Early Modern Religious Iconography: Female saints and feminine Jesus; 3) yin/yang 陰陽 medical cosmology and representation of the feminine (female ghosts and fox women) in Strange Tales From a Chinese Studio (Liaozhai zhi yi 聊齋誌異). We ask how these imaginative ideas of human anatomy and cultural expression of gender and sexuality challenge our understandings of what it means to be men and women today. Critical examination of these representations suggests that sex, gender, and sexuality were largely social and cultural constructions before modern biomedical knowledge about human bodies took hold.   

Upon completion of this course, students will:
1. Demonstrate a fair understanding of cultural discourses on gender and sexuality.
2. Exhibit a comprehension of the interdisciplinary approaches for analyzing gender, sex, and sexuality.
3. Demonstrate adequate written and oral communication skills within various formal and informal circumstances.

課程概述:
History of states（國家學） explores the idea of the “State” and how state power has evolved in Eastern and Western traditions.
As an interdisciplinary course, it introduces core concepts of political order, legitimacy, sovereignty, state formation, and
institutional organization. Rather than treating the state as an abstract idea, the course examines how different states are imagined,
created, justified and challenged. Through case studies such as the French Republic and United Nations, students connect theory
with historical practice and critically assess competing forms of statehood and political authority.
國家學導論探討「國家」這個概念，以及國家權力如何在不同歷史脈絡中形成和演變。作為一門學術交叉的課程，本課程將介紹政治秩序、權力正當、主權思維、國家形成與制度組織等核心概念。課程在抽象的理論之外將會討論實際的案例，追問不同國家如何被創造、權力如何正當化。透過法國革命，三十年戰爭和聯合國的創建等等不同的案例，學生將在案例中瞭解理論的實踐，并且進一步批判不同國家的形態與政治權威的競爭。

This course "Talking on Modern Rights"（比較憲法） will provide a comparative perspective on civil rights in different states
and international contracts, the course will explore the historical foundation and contemporary challenges of basic rights through a
comparative lens, focusing on the Constitution of United States and the Basic Law “Grundgesetz” of Germany. Starting with the
philosophical explanation of natural rights, human rights and constitutional rights, the lecture will illustrate the tension between the is and the ought. The course will further examine specific constitutional protections in the U.S. Bill of Rights and the
German Grundgesetz, national protection of rights that are anchored alongside international treaties and human rights conventions.
Basic rights such as freedom of speech, freedom of religion, protection of property will be analyzed across different constitutional
systems, against the background of contemporary menace to these rights such as digital surveillance, climate change,
disinformation, and the rise of populism. By the end of the semester, students will have gained a critical understanding of civil
rights and the diversity of constitutional traditions, the theoretical understanding should then be proven by individual presentations
and analysis of controversial cases.
比較憲法是一門從比較視角探討不同國家的公民權利與基本權利的課程。本課程全英文授課，將以美國憲法與德國《基本法》（Grundgesetz）為核心，追溯歐美憲法的歷史基礎，並討論其在當代社會所面臨的挑戰。課程首先從自然權利、人權與憲法權利的哲學基礎出發，說明「現實如何存在」與「規範應當如何」的議題。課程將進一步分析美國《權利法案》與德國《基本法》中具體的憲法保障。探討言論自由、宗教自由、財產權保障等基本權利，課程將在不同憲政傳統 中進行權利的比較和分析。學期結束時，學生將能夠批判性地理解公民權利的意義、基本權利保障的多樣性，以及不同憲法傳統如何回應現代社會的政治與法律挑戰。學生也將透過個人報告與爭議案例分析，將理論理解轉化為具體的判斷能力。

After completing the course, students can 1) Appreciate art & architecture through the lens of social and art history, 2) Enhance cross-cultural competence and aesthetic literacy, 3) Enhance communicative and presentation skills.

Therefore, there has been a growing demand from industry to educate science and engineering students in entrepreneurship. The curriculum is centered on three key aspects of entrepreneurship: 1) the individual, the skills, and attributes that make entrepreneurs successful, 2) the business ideas, how to generate them, where to look for them, and 3) how to ensure that business ideas are valid and have potential for success (e.g. innovative technology market deployment, meeting profit goals). 依照本系內容，分為「食品化學與營養」、「食品加工．包裝與儲存」、「微生物與生物技術」、「食品經濟與經營管理」等４個領域，由各領域的1名老師授課。

利用sas軟體分析，建立學生對資料數據的處理，結果之研判及實驗工作的規劃(採用統計設計方式)。首先就族群與樣品的差異予以探討，統計時產生可能錯誤(Type I,Type II)緣由，及由族群所用的Z分布及應用時的t分布，變方分析中的單因子設計(CRD,RCBD,Latin Square)與複因子設計。迥歸分析(Simple & Multiple regression)的由來及應用。二項分布及卜瓦松分布及非母數分析常用的方法包括chi-square 、rank test等各種方法。
介紹各種加工與保存的技術將農，畜，水產的原料製成方便食用的產品, 包括加熱、脫水、冷藏冷凍、發酵等各種基礎的食品加工技術, 並探討加工過程中品質的變化,分析糧食資源的利用以及討論自然環境的關係。

課程概述: 食品創新實務主要是訓練學生統整過去所學的基礎 及專業知識，瞭解當代消費市場的產品趨勢及商業模式，嘗試開發新的產品、技術創新或新創行銷模式，期能學用合一，強化職場競爭力。

本課程之教學先以“課程導引”將學期課程的內容大綱、上課模式與評量方法作一初步的介紹。介紹不同的食材搭配，使學生理解食材的季節性，選擇當季的食材來進行加工與利用，及應用食材於食品加工與前處理部分，分析問題可能發生情形的能力。再分別進行以下內容說明：
1.介紹各類型食物的分類
2.各種食材的基本性質
3.各食材之間的交互作用
4.在蔬菜與水果的介紹中，加入有機蔬果與飲食行為健康的概念性介紹介紹適用於加工的食品原料、包括來自農、漁、牧業的各種農產品。說明這些原料的加工產品及用途，討論與分析食品加工製造與上游原料的關係，以及原料性質對加工作業的重要性。

本課程之教學內容包含植物基原料加工特性與原理、案例導引與實作訓練三大部分：
1.蔬果加工特性與原理:獲得蔬果加工之原理，並在課程後段以產品實例進行說明，讓學生了解蔬果加工之相關知識。
2.穀類加工特性與原理:獲得蔬果加工之原理，並在課程後段以產品實例進行說明，讓學生了解穀類加工之相關知識。
2.案例導引則列舉食品及餐飲相關研發與行銷案例，以加深印象。
3.實作部分則於課程單元之中設定主題進行小組討論，並穿插分組訓練實作能力，使學生熟悉蔬果與穀類簡易加工特性，並於期末驗收總結成果報告，且支援加工原料學等學門之相關知識。使了解蔬果與穀類在加工適性上的差異性，並針對不同的蔬果與穀類加工產品製程有進一步的了解。

本課程將介紹公司財務的功能與內容，透過個案的研討，讓學生思考如何將財務專業引入公司的經營，創造公司最高的價值。本課程闡述公司財務的工作內容與涵蓋範圍，使學生對於財務的功能有正確的認知。由於公司的目標就是要創造公司價值，因此本課程亦會使學生從簡單的價值觀念開始，到最後理解創造價值策略的形成。縱使學生本身並非從事財務工作，亦可透過本課程瞭解如何判斷公司是否健全與是否是具有價值，進而輔助本身的財務能力，課程主題包括財務報表分析、投資評估、融資決策與股利政策等。此外，本課程亦從宏觀經濟角度切入，透過金融時事與國際經濟個案導讀，深入剖析全球主要經濟與金融議題，培養學員結合宏觀經濟與政策因素，制訂更有效的國際投資決策與企業營運資金管理策略，內容涵蓋利率、匯率、物價、金融危機，貨幣與財政政策，以利學生能夠建立具理論與實務的一致性。

課程概述:

模組一：戰略定位與雙軸視野 (The Vision)
核心：解決「為什麼要轉型」與「轉向哪裡」的戰略問題。
此模組整合了在 APEC、產官學論壇及產業政策面的高度，確立企業在國際賽道上的定位。
• 關鍵內容分配：
o 雙軸轉型戰略： 數位綠色雙軸轉型（Digital & Green）、APEC 數位創新低碳轉型工作坊的經驗分享。
o 產業韌性與趨勢： 國家與產業韌性論壇、機械產業三軸轉型（數位、淨零、人才）。
o 全球化布局： 品牌力量走出國際、全球品牌策略。
• 教學目標： 幫助學員跳脫單一企業視角，從全球供應鏈與政策高度審視轉型的迫切性。

模組二：智慧實踐與數位賦能 (The Practice)
核心：解決「如何透過技術創造價值」的落地問題。
此模組運用在「台中精機」的實戰案例，將技術轉化為可複製的商業實踐。
• 關鍵內容分配：
o 智造落地： 打造智慧工廠
o AI 與新科技： 技術賦能、AI 網路安全新紀元、AI 驅動轉型。
o 行銷與運營數位化： 台中精機的數位行銷之路、供應鏈碳盤查實務。
• 教學目標： 提供具體的「實踐路徑圖」，讓學員看到從傳產跨入 AI 智造的真實挑戰與解法。

模組三：組織治理與傳承創新 (The People)
核心：解決「誰來領導」與「如何長青」的組織靈魂問題。融合了「接班經驗」、「女性領導力」與「組織心理學」背景。
• 關鍵內容分配：
o 接班與傳承： 從接班到雙軸轉型、接班突圍下的安內穩定、二代思維。
o 文化與領導力： 企業組織文化 vs. 淨零排放、女性領導力論壇、社會創新。
o 心法與哲學： 企業的成長與蛻變、承繼與創新的永續之道、不確定性中的轉機。
• 教學目標： 探討「人的轉型」，處理接班衝突、文化重塑與領導者的心智進化。

課程名稱: 土地使用管制、資產活化實務

課程概述: 這門課程旨在從多元角度解析不動產相關法規體系，涵蓋地政、土地管制、營建管理、產業發展、稅務政策、交易秩序、環境保護、公產管理及相關特別法等領域。課程將系統性梳理法律架構，結合法律優先原則，透過實務案例深入探討普通法與特別法的適用優先順序，並解析法律、法規命令、主管機關解釋及行政裁量之間的相互關係與競合問題。再者，本課程亦從地權視角出發，探討共有土地的處分、整合與分割議題，並深入分析不動產信託、遺產繼承、贈與及地籍測量等實務操作。此外，針對農地及工業用地的使用管制、移轉限制與交易成本，以及違章工廠轉型相關法規問題也將一併涵蓋。課程特別邀請業界專家，以簡明易懂的方式分享豐富的實務經驗，帶領學員深入了解不動產領域的多元面貌與挑戰。

課程簡介：
本課程旨在提供學員具實務導向的經營管理知識，協助其面對當前快速變遷的商業環境與組織挑戰。透過本課程，學員不僅掌握全球與本地的經營管理趨勢，更能從實際案例中獲得啟發，轉化為適合自身企業的經營行動方案，成為具備國際視野與實務執行力的現代領導者。本課程透過多元經典案例分析，結合經濟、財務、政策、產業與行銷管理，探討全球與本地企業面臨的經營挑戰與策略調整。內容涵蓋總體經濟、利率、通膨、匯率、景氣迴圈等經濟議題，並延伸至行銷、產銷、人力、財務、創新與策略發展等管理領域，提供最新的市場趨勢與第一手經營經驗，培養具備跨領域整合能力與實務操作經驗，學員將能從不同角度重新思考企業經營的核心邏輯與應對策略。

1.在讓學員了解整個不動產範疇與架構，相關產業現況與發展趨勢，以不動產開發生命週期的過程，介紹每個產業在其中所扮演的角色、功能、定位，並邀請產業要角、領導人詳盡介紹產業現況。
2.不動產分析的範疇，包含法令、市場、財務分析，本課程以集思廣益的方式，探討三大分析內容、架構，讓學員了解要成為不動產達人，需要具備哪些職能，作為自身修習課程欲精進的目標。

課程名稱: 不動產開發形象、品牌定位
課程概述: 本課程聚焦於企業文化塑造與品牌建立，本課程透過建築美學、實際建案案例以及頂級民宿參訪，深入探討品牌聯想、關鍵影響力及市場行銷實務，並延伸至企業永續經營（ESG）策略的應用。學員將藉此機會深入理解房地產產業的精髓與美學。教學方式採用專題研究與實地參訪，並透過師生課堂互動，促進理論與實務結合。課程分享如何塑造建案品牌價值，並展現建築獨有的品質與魅力，帶領學員體驗建築與品牌經營的深層面向，以形塑建案品牌價值。

課程目標：本課程旨在協助研究生建立科學研究的基本素養與能力，熟悉高齡健康與運動科學領域常用之研究設計與資料分析方法。課程強調研究倫理、問題意識、假設建構、研究設計、測量工具選擇與資料處理的系統性訓練，培養學生獨立進行量化與質化研究的能力，為撰寫碩士論文及未來從事研究或實務工作奠定紮實基礎。

課程內涵：
研究基本概念與倫理：介紹科學研究的本質、研究流程、學術誠信與倫理原則，提升學生的研究自覺與責任感。
研究問題與假設建構：教導如何從文獻中找出研究問題、界定研究變項，並撰寫具邏輯性與可驗證性的研究假設。
研究設計類型：涵蓋實驗研究、準實驗設計、橫斷式與縱貫式調查、個案研究與行動研究等，針對高齡與運動情境中常見的設計型式進行說明與實例探討。
量化研究方法：講授抽樣技術、問卷設計、信效度檢定、常用統計方法（如T檢定、ANOVA、相關與迴歸分析）與資料處理技巧。
質性研究方法：介紹質性研究的理念與基本取徑（如訪談、觀察、焦點團體等），以及資料分析方式（如主題分析、內容分析）。
文獻回顧與資料蒐集技巧：訓練學生進行系統性文獻搜尋、整理與引用，強化其學術資料分析與整合能力。
研究計畫撰寫實作：安排期中期末作業，引導學生撰寫具體可行之研究計畫書，並進行口頭簡報與同儕回饋，提升其研究設計與表達能力。

課程概述:
We need to better understand ecological complexity, as solution to many crucial environmental problems depends on it. In the context of modern global trade systems, human society has become so highly interconnected that nearly every component has the potential to influence others. As a result, the effects of human activities are now detectable almost everywhere, including regions traditionally regarded as wilderness. Furthermore, ecosystems cannot be understood or managed in isolation. Effective management of ecosystems and species in any given area requires an understanding of their position within the broader global environmental context. This challenge has become increasingly pressing, as environmental management is now often a race between conservation and exploitation. 
	Modern computing technologies have equipped landscape ecology with a diverse set of tools, including geographic information systems (GIS) for analyzing landscapes, databases and data warehouses to for managing environmental information, and virtual reality for simulating environmental conditions. At the same time, advances in communication technologies have made these resources widely available online, such that “e-science” is now potentially accessible to users worldwide. The integration of landscape ecology with GIS and remote sensing is essential for understanding ecological complexity across multiple spatial and temporal scales.

開課系所名稱: 國際學院不分系英語學士班
課程概述: Apart from technological knowledge, employees of the 21st century are expected to have skills in areas such as problem-solving, creative thinking, written and oral communication, and teamwork. Therefore, there has been a growing demand from industry to educate science and engineering students in entrepreneurship. The curriculum is centered on three key aspects of entrepreneurship: 1) the individual, the skills, and attributes that make entrepreneurs successful, 2) the business ideas, how to generate them, where to look for them, and 3) how to ensure that business ideas are valid and have potential for success (e.g. innovative technology market deployment, meeting profit goals). Topics include entrepreneurial thinking; recognizing and creating opportunity; innovation technology roadmap (from laboratory to market deployment); industry and market research; innovation protection and management (patent search; how to draft the application); business strategy; business models and business plans; financial requirements and fundraising (investors search); start-up barriers and how to overcome them. This course will be taught entirely in English.

課程概述:
全民國防是近年來在國防事務領域上相當熱門的概念，在意義上與總體國防相近，是由全民共同積極參與，配合國家軍事力量，在經濟戰、社會戰、心理戰等建設性層面強化國防、阻絕侵略。簡單的說，全民國防即是動員全民的力量來完成防衛國家的任務。

  「全民國防教育」主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，並述及我國安全情勢與兩岸情勢等，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，增進對國家的認同。「全民國防教育軍事訓練」篇則介紹軍人禮節、警衛勤務以及軍紀、軍法和愛國教育等課程，為使學生充分理解，特別以國防故事補充說明，讓學生透過故事性的陳述，了解課程重要性。

課程名稱: 淨零排放與碳市場發展
AI與ESG永續淨零碳排與半導體產業趨勢講座
課程概述:
本課程以「ESG 永續發展」為核心，結合「實體AI、機器人、智慧製造」等新興產業趨勢，探討企業如何在淨零轉型、數位轉型與智慧化升級的浪潮中，重新建構競爭力與永續價值。
課程前半部聚焦於 ESG、淨零碳排、碳管理、綠色供應鏈與永續商業模式，使學生理解企業面對國際永續規範、碳費制度、供應鏈減碳壓力與綠色金融時，所需具備的策略思維。
課程後半部則導入實體AI、機器人、智慧製造、數位雙生、AIoT、自動化生產與產業應用案例，說明 AI 不再只是軟體工具，而是逐漸進入工廠、倉儲、醫療、服務業與城市治理場域，成為推動產業升級的重要力量。
本課程透過專題演講、產業案例、趨勢分析與期末報告，引導學生理解 ESG 與智慧科技並非兩條平行線，而是未來企業轉型、產業創新與社會永續發展的重要交會點。

課程概述:
本課程旨在介紹生成式人工智慧（Generative AI）之核心概念、技術原理、應用模式與未來發展，培養學生對人工智慧科技的基本理解與實作能力。課程內容涵蓋人工智慧的發展歷程、AI分類與運作原理、生成式AI之文字、圖像與影音生成技術，以及生成式AI於教育、產業、媒體與日常生活中的應用案例。
課程安排生成式AI實作與案例分析，透過跨領域應用情境，引導學生思考AI技術如何協助解決問題、提升工作效率與創造新型態服務。期末將以生成式AI實作成果作為整合性學習評量，培養學生面對未來AI時代所需之數位素養、創新能力與跨域整合能力。

這是一門專為非理工背景學生設計的「AI 科技駕馭與場域規劃」核心課程。本課程將以深入淺出的方式，解析鑑別式與生成式AI的底層邏輯，帶領無程式背景的學生了解多模態AI工具及提示工程（Prompt Engineering）。同時，課程將融合運算思維與 No-Code / Low-Code自動化概念，並探討AI治理、政策法規與資料隱私安全。透過理論與實務的結合，旨在培養學生在面對特定場域時，具備基本的風險辨識，以及提出AI導入規劃方案的應用能力。

課程概述: 本課程旨在培養具全球視野的公民素養。首先，引導學生理解人類共同面臨的全球性挑戰，建立世界公民意識與責任感。課程注重議題探究與批判思考，鼓勵以多元觀點剖析社會現象，理性分析公共議題的因果與價值衝突，提出合理主張。同時培養媒體素養，幫助學生在假新聞與後真相時代中辨識資訊真偽與偏誤，提升判斷力。透過小組討論與模擬情境，學生將強化溝通協調與合作能力，學習理性對話與民主參與。課程亦強調永續發展，鼓勵理解氣候變遷對環境與社會的衝擊，並付諸實踐。最後，學生將連結在地行動與國際趨勢，理解台灣於全球議題中的角色，培養兼具在地關懷與國際視野的公民素養。

開課系所名稱: 精緻農業學士學位學程
課程概述:
本課程介紹生物學給生命科學專業的學生，為進入生命科學領域奠定紮實的基礎。
課程目的在使未來專業在分子生物、遺傳工程、生態保育或跨學科之領域的學生，皆能因充分認識地球上的生物多樣性與生態系統而認知生命現象及其豐富。本學期課程藉講演和視聽教材依序介紹生物的起源與演化，認識微生物、植物與動物的多樣性、形態結構和生理功能。

開課系所名稱: 精緻農業學士學位學程
課程概述:
本課程課程旨在培養兼具專業理論與實作能力的高階農業人才，重點涵蓋有機與健康農業、高科技設施農業、農業生物技術、品牌行銷與休閒觀光。從精緻農業實際例子，使學生了解如何利用農業知識改善生活及與其專業結合，提升學生學習成效，增進論述、論證、審問及思辨等能力。
內涵：嶄新的農業願景是創造國人新的生活價值，是「軟國力」的展現。為落實產業發展，人才培育為重要之基石，強調「從做中學」精神，內容涵蓋「精緻農業概論」、「休閒產業發展」、「有機與健康農業」、「農產品行銷」，內容包含農委會推動之三大願景中的多項產業，如「健康農業」之有機農業、安全農業；「卓越農業」之農業生物技術、蘭花、觀賞魚、種畜禽；「樂活農業」之農業深度旅遊、休閒產業、農村旅遊、生態旅遊、農業精品產製與行銷等。不僅平常有專業的理論基礎，更提供了豐富的實習操作機會，未來，可利用進步的生技技術優勢，讓臺灣農業不僅是靠勞力的初級產業，而是走向行銷、服務面向，建立特有品牌與提升品質的高技術產業，以立體化、精細化、高端化為發展主軸。

開課系所名稱: 精緻農業學士學位學程
課程概述:
課程目標：1.教導學生熟悉作物生產之基本原理。 2. 了解田間作物實際生長過程中所面臨之問題與其專業結合。 3.訓練學生處理作物生產問題之能力與技巧。4.期待學生能透過本課程強化對作物生產原理的實作，了解田間作物實際生長過程中所面臨之問題。
內涵：包括農業之重要性與發展、作物起源與分類、作物分布與生產狀況、農業生態、作物生產系統、作物與水、土壤與植物養分、作物種子與播種、作物根部、作物莖部與葉部、光合作用與呼吸作用、開花與生殖、作物改良、氣候、天氣與作物、作物害物與控制、作物病害與控制、雜草與雜草控制、植物生長調節劑、作物產量品質與生產技術、以及永續農業與作物生產，期待學生對於作物生產有初步了解。

開課系所名稱: 精緻農業學士學位學程

課程概述:
以CERFA1 能力為教學目標，包含:
主要是幫助學習者掌握基本的語言技能，使他們能夠在日常生活中進行基本的交流。具體目標包括：

聽力：
1.理解日常生活中的基本對話，如問候、介紹、購物、點餐等。
2.聽懂簡單的指示和問題。

口語：
1.能夠進行簡單的自我介紹和互動，如介紹自己、家庭成員、興趣愛好等。
2.使用基本句型和詞彙進行日常交流，如詢問價格、問路、點餐等。

閱讀：
1.理解簡單的短文、對話和公告，如餐館菜單、交通標誌、簡單的故事等。
2.認識常見的漢字和基本詞彙。

寫作：
1.能夠寫簡單的句子和短文，如自我介紹、介紹家人等。
2.使用基本的語法結構和詞彙

這些目標旨在幫助初學者建立語言基礎，使他們能夠在真實的語境中應用所學，增強學習動機和自信心。

了解基本的華人溝通文化，能詮釋華人溝通的非語言訊息傳遞，知道如何與華人應對進退。

課程名稱: 中文發音訓練：注音與拼音
舞動中文：透過身體律動學習華語

評分方式.說明: Formative Character Quiz 1 Formative Character Quiz 2 Formative Character Quiz 3 Final Comprehensive Test

Midterm Performance   Group performance (6%)   Individual oral report (4.5%)   Written reflection (4.5%) Final Performance   Dual-song medley (10%)   Individual improvisation (4%)   Group reflection report (3%)   Learning portfolio (3%)

Movement Vocabulary Videos   Video 1: Character Body Calligraphy (3%)   Video 2: Porcelain Lyric Interpretation (4%)   Video 3: Style Contrast (4%)   Video 4: Personal Movement Collection (4%) Class Participation Learning Journals (Weeks 5, 10, 15)

課程概述:
This embodied Chinese learning course pursues three mutually integrated objectives, developing students’ comprehensive language competence through dance and movement.
First, the cognitive-linguistic objective aims to help students master over 100 core Chinese vocabulary items and achieve accurate tonal pronunciation. Through the analysis of aesthetic symbols in Zhongguo Feng (Chinese-style) music, understanding the historical contexts of blue-and-white porcelain art and agricultural traditions, and comparing the differences between classical and modern Chinese expression found in song lyrics, students will cultivate deep cultural literacy.
Second, the affective-motivational objective seeks to build language learning confidence through creative expression, foster a collaborative spirit through group choreography, develop intercultural empathy and sensitivity, and establish a supportive learning community in which students feel a strong sense of belonging and achievement, thereby nurturing intrinsic motivation and cultural appreciation.
Third, the skill-performance objective focuses on developing students’ ability to execute classical and modern Chinese dance movements while transforming character strokes into embodied calligraphy, fluently singing rhythmic lyrics with accurate tonal control, expressing emotional nuances through diverse movement qualities, and ultimately creating a personalized movement vocabulary that establishes lasting connections among physical expression, linguistic meaning, and cultural understanding. Through this tripartite framework, students will not only enhance their language proficiency but also gain a holistic, embodied understanding of the Chinese language and culture.

課程概述: 教、學並重，寓教於生活並接軌於學術。注重語言教學與生活體驗的互動，希望學生所學能活用於生活實踐。語音、詞彙、語義是語言習得的基礎，也是此課程重要的教學目標。學生在完成本課程後，能了解並使用熟悉的日常表達方式，及使用非常簡單之詞彙以求滿足基礎需求。能介紹自己及他人並能針對個人背景資料，例如住在哪裡、認識何人以及擁有什麼事物等問題作出問答。能在對方語速緩慢、用詞清晰並提供協助的前提下作簡單的交流。聽力：在對方說話緩 慢且清晰，並隨時準備提供協助的前提下，能聽懂基本短語或常用詞。口說：能簡短地回答與個人生活密切相關的問題。例如：住在哪裡、認識什麼人、擁有的事物等。 能使用熟悉的日常用語與詞彙簡單地描述人物、地點及物品。 閱讀：在有視覺協助及可重複閱讀的情況下，能掌握基本數字、詞彙及簡單的短語並能大致理解句子內容。 寫作：能寫出簡單、不連貫的短語和句子。
